description: instagram: Post/Reel Info. GET /v1/instagram/post. Get a public Instagram post or reel by URL (/p/, /reel/, /reels/ or /tv/), as a signed-out visitor sees it: media URLs, caption, owner (with follower count), like and comment counts, duration, music, date and location. video_view_count is Instagram's older view count; for the plays Instagram shows on a reel, set include_play_count=true. Comment edges are empty (comments need a login). Private or removed posts fail at Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

cache_max_age.description: Use a cached response this old or newer for 0 credits. If none is available, fetch live at the endpoint’s normal price.

download_media.description: Not supported: download_media=true returns 400. Use video_url or display_url in the response.

include_play_count.description: Set to true to add play_count (also as video_play_count) for a reel: the plays Instagram shows, the same number as /v1/instagram/user/reels. Read from the owner's 12 newest reels; null for older ones.

region.description: Accepted for compatibility. Instagram's public pages are read from the US.

trim.description: Set to true for a trimmed response.

url.description: The URL of the post or reel

name: instagram_post
